hero.title: Our Network
hero.description: Delivery Worker Atlas is built by a network of work and collaboration. We bring together people with different trajectories, institutions, and areas of expertise who, in complementary ways, help produce, analyze, and share data on app-based delivery work in Brazil. Our network includes researchers, developers, designers, activists, and institutional partners who believe in the use of data as a tool to strengthen workers and broaden public debate on the future of work.

people.name: Igor Vecchia
people.description: Geographer and doctoral researcher studying platform delivery work and its relationship with the production of urban space.
people.contributions: Overall project coordination, research development, data analysis, development of data-collection and visualization methodologies, coordination with institutional partners, production of texts and reports, and organization of events and debates.

people.name: Quinn
people.description: Software developer with experience in web applications and data visualization.
people.contributions: Software development, including the implementation of user authentication, login, and access management functionalities, as well as contributions to the development, maintenance, and improvement of the platform.

people.name: Daniel
people.description: Software developer with experience in web applications and data visualization.
people.contributions: Management and coordination of software development activities, including the organization of technical tasks, development planning, coordination of implementation processes, and oversight of the platform's technical development.

people.name: Ian
people.description: Developer with experience in web applications, geospatial data, and visualization.
people.contributions: Software development, implementation and improvement of web application features, user interfaces, and data visualization components, contributing to the functionality, usability, and ongoing development of the platform.
